verdict.rationale: Maritime has no single built-in assistant for operating the platform. It does let users deploy ready-made template agents in a few clicks and delegate tasks to them. Those agents run on Maritime's default metered LLM access, can set their own schedules from a chat request ("send me a digest every weekday at 9"), can act on the user's behalf through connected accounts, and can be pointed at a runbook to migrate workloads into Maritime agents. Missing for 10: a native in-product assistant that is built in rather than deployed from a template, documentation of it handling platform-management tasks from the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
